title: Veer Akbar Veer Akbar
body:
Aye Jawaan Laal Teri Kaash Jo Shaadi Hoti
tere Bacho Ko Khilaati Mai Bhi Daadi Hoti
soch Kar Roti Hai Aksar Maadar
<<MINI>>
veer Akbar Veer Akbar
ye Bata Jaa Mujhko Kaise Jiye Maa
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Hai Kaahaa Laal Mera Koi Mujhe Batlaaye
mujhse Naaraz Hai Gar Koi Mana Kar Laaye
neend Aati Nahi Mujhko Pal Bhar
<<MINI>>
veer Akbar Veer Akbar
ye Bata Jaa Mujhko Kaise Jiye Maa
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Kaise Mai Chaaun Me Baithungi Bhala Socho To
dhoop Me Dekhte Jaati Hu Tere Laashe Ko
ab Nahi Jeene Ki Teri Maadar
<<MINI>>
veer Akbar Veer Akbar
ye Bata Jaa Mujhko Kaise Jiye Maa
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Ek Ek Saans Meri Aaj Bani Hai Bhaala
ek Ek Roz Mere Waaste Hai Aashura
maa Ka Sukh Chain Gaye Tum Leker
<<MINI>>
veer Akbar Veer Akbar
ye Bata Jaa Mujhko Kaise Jiye Maa
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Leke Angdaai Jawaan Laal Ne Todi Barchi
bole Shabbir Jawaani Hai Tere Daada Ki
tum The Atthaara Baras Ke Haider
<<MINI>>
veer Akbar Veer Akbar
ye Bata Jaa Mujhko Kaise Jiye Maa
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Tujhko Naiza Jo Laga Mere Jigar Me Aaya
dard Seene Me Utha Dil Hua Paara Paara
ab Talak Ghaaun Hai Dil Ke Ander
<<MINI>>
veer Akbar Veer Akbar
ye Bata Jaa Mujhko Kaise Jiye Maa
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Maatami Tere Jawaan Laal Sabhi Shaad Rahe
sab Azaadar Mere Laal Ke Aabad Rahe
pursa Dete Hai Mujhe Ro Ro Kar
<<MINI>>
veer Akbar Veer Akbar
ye Bata Jaa Mujhko Kaise Jiye Maa
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Hai Ye Laila Ki Fughaa Ho Ye Jawaan Ka Matam
karne Aaye Hai Jawaan Aaj Jawaan Ka Matam
yaad Teri Hai Dilo Par Khanjar
<<MINI>>
veer Akbar Veer Akbar
ye Bata Jaa Mujhko Kaise Jiye Maa
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Tumko Akbar Ki Jawaani Ki Qasam Ahle Azaa
yaad Rakhna Ali Akbar Ka Ye Haidar Nauha
ilteja Karta Hai Rokar Daawar
<<MINI>>
veer Akbar Veer Akbar
ye Bata Jaa Mujhko Kaise Jiye Maa
